hint: Type 'map' to see the floor. The stair down is in the room furthest from where you arrived.

traps.text: A flagstone sinks under your boot. Darts hiss from the wall!
traps.avoid: You spot a tripwire at ankle height and step neatly over it.

traps.text: The floor gives way and you drop waist-deep into a pit of old spikes.
traps.avoid: The dust lies wrong on one flagstone. You walk around it.

traps.text: A blade swings out of the ceiling, low and fast.
traps.avoid: You hear the click a heartbeat before the blade and duck under it.

floors.name: The Crypt
ambient: Dust sifts down from the ceiling.
Something small scuttles away from your light.
floors.arrival: The stair ends in cold, dry air and the smell of old stone. The Crypt.

start.name: Crypt Stair
start.text: The foot of the stair. Rows of sealed niches march away into the dark.

plain.name: Burial Niche
plain.text: Shelves of bones line the walls, each skull turned to face the door.

plain.name: Ossuary
plain.text: Bones are stacked here like firewood, sorted by somebody with a tidy mind.

plain.name: Mourners' Hall
plain.text: Stone benches face an empty bier. Dried flowers crumble underfoot.

plain.name: Candle Gallery
plain.text: Hundreds of wax stubs cling to the walls. None of them have been lit in your lifetime.

plain.name: Sexton's Store
plain.text: Spades, rope and a wheelbarrow with one wheel. Somebody's lunch, a century old.

plain.name: Collapsed Vault
plain.text: Half the ceiling has come down. You pick your way between slabs.

stairs.name: Warden's Gate
stairs.text: A gatehouse built underground, for reasons the builders took with them. Behind its arch a stair winds further down.

treasure.name: Reliquary
treasure.text: A small vaulted room, its walls painted with saints nobody remembers.

shrine.name: Chapel of the Candle
shrine.text: A side-chapel no bigger than a cupboard. Somebody still tends it, or something does.

merchant.name: Peddler's Nook
merchant.text: An alcove hung with blankets, lit by a green lantern, crammed with merchandise.

floors.name: The Flooded Vaults
ambient: Something moves under the surface and is gone.
The cold here gets into your teeth.
floors.arrival: The stair runs out into black water. Somewhere a river is talking to itself. The Flooded Vaults.

start.name: Vault Stair
start.text: The last steps are under water. Arches recede in every direction, doubled in the black mirror of the flood.

plain.name: Flooded Gallery
plain.text: Black water stands knee-deep, perfectly still until you step into it.

plain.name: Sunken Archive
plain.text: Shelves of ledgers have swollen into a single grey mass. Ink bleeds through the water.

plain.name: Pump Room
plain.text: A great brass pump stands seized and green. The river won this argument long ago.

plain.name: Dripping Cistern
plain.text: Every surface runs with water. The echo makes it sound as if someone is walking behind you.

plain.name: Miners' Mess
plain.text: Tin plates float gently between the tables.

plain.name: Weed-Choked Passage
plain.text: Pale weed hangs from the ceiling and strokes your face as you pass.

stairs.name: Drowned Stair
stairs.text: A wide stair descends into the flood and, somehow, out the other side of it, dry, into warmer air.

treasure.name: Strongroom
treasure.text: The door hangs off its hinges. Whoever broke in did not get out; they are still here, in a corner.

treasure.name: Paymaster's Office
treasure.text: A desk, a ledger, and a floor scattered with a century of unpaid wages.

shrine.name: Shrine of the Dry Step
shrine.text: A single stone stands clear of the water, and on it a candle burns.

merchant.name: Peddler's Raft
merchant.text: A raft of doors lashed together, piled with merchandise, moored to a pillar under a green lantern.

floors.name: The Hollow Court
ambient: Warm ash drifts across the floor.
Far off, something breathes like a bellows.
floors.arrival: It is warm down here. It should not be warm. Ahead, firelight moves on carved stone. The Hollow Court.

start.name: Court Stair
start.text: The stair opens onto a colonnade of blackened pillars. Firelight flickers at the far end of everything.

plain.name: Hall of Banners
plain.text: Banners hang in rows, burned to lace. The crests on them are all the same crown.

plain.name: Scorched Gallery
plain.text: The walls are glazed where something very hot went by, many times.

plain.name: Courtiers' Walk
plain.text: Suits of court dress stand in the alcoves. They are empty. You count them twice anyway.

plain.name: Cinder Garden
plain.text: Stone trees, stone fountain, and a drift of warm ash where the flowerbeds were.

plain.name: Armoury
plain.text: Racks of weapons, each rusted to its bracket. The King kept the good ones.

plain.name: Antechamber
plain.text: The air tastes of smoke, and from somewhere ahead comes a sound like a slow bellows.

boss.name: The Throne Room
boss.text: A hall of pillars, and at its end a throne of fused iron. Heat beats from it like a forge.

treasure.name: Royal Treasury
treasure.text: Most of it melted long ago into one glittering puddle. Not all of it.

treasure.name: The King's Chamber
treasure.text: A bed of ash, a wardrobe of ash, and one chest that would not burn.

shrine.name: The Last Candle
shrine.text: In a niche behind the pillars, far from the throne, a small flame burns cool and steady.

arrival: The stair keeps going. Nobody ever drew a map of this far down.
Colder again. Your light seems to reach a little less far than it did.
The steps are worn hollow in the middle, as if by a great many feet going one way.

boss.name: Echo of the Hollow King
boss.battle_intro: The throne is occupied. It should not be. You have already killed what sits there.
boss.defeat_text: The Echo comes apart into sparks, and the sparks go out one by one.

on_defeat.say: Where the Echo stood, a {item}Heart Root{/} is pushing up through the flagstones.
